title: migrate-layout
description: What migrate layout answers: that there was nothing to migrate, or how each view comes out, how many Group files lose their size, and on a real run each step it ran and what tidying each view's lines did.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always MigrateLayout, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: Nothing to do, or what migrating did or would do.

nothing.description: Why there was nothing to migrate, in words for people; present only then, and then nothing else but groups.

report.description: How each view comes out of migrating a version 1 layout.yml; empty when the layout was version 2.

groups.description: How many Group files lose the size they carried, which the layout now keeps.

steps.description: Each command the migration ran, in order; present only on a real run, never on --dry-run.

tidied.description: What tidying each view's lines did, one entry per view, when the lines were tidied.
